name: telegram.com
body: Every page has a title, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: www.telegram.com scores 61 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 10 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 6 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /obituaries, /public-notices, /marketplace/jobs/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 78 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 14 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /story/sports/baseball/woosox/2026/10/21/chad-epperson-worcester-red-sox-manager-2027/92366748007/, for example #alertManager,#banner-92367946007_NTEG,.main-text. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 201 ms
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
